issue_context.summary: Distinguish intentional floating flyout size from clipped replacement-help text
inferences: The proposed mechanism is provisional and is not an executed runtime result or evidence that the old report is fixed.
known_information: The inspected German screenshot shows replacement-help content extending beyond the parent and clipped text; those are separate observations.
Participants question whether exceeding the parent size is itself a bug. The linked text-clipping report33906is closed as duplicate, with no closing PR recorded.
Current MainWindow.xaml intentionally sets DateTimeFlyout.ShouldConstrainToRootBounds=False; parent size alone is not the correct acceptance condition.
issue_context.analysis: A floating help flyout may legitimately exceed the PowerRename parent. Localized content clipping still warrants a text-layout/work-area reproduction; do not remove the intentional unconstrained-root setting merely to fit the parent.
initial_investigation: Read all discussion, inspected the supplied German screenshot and read the complete linked33906discussion/closure metadata.
Verified current-main MainWindow.xaml flyout configuration; no current screenshot reproduction or shipped text-layout fix is claimed.

fix_assessment.rationale: An observable failure is reported and a specific investigation boundary is identified. The proposed direction remains conditional on controlled reproduction.

prerequisites: Use a disposable test environment and test-owned documents/configuration; preserve existing user data.
steps: Use current PowerRename with German localization and test filenames; open replacement syntax help at normal and minimum parent size.
Repeat at100,150and200percent scaling and near each screen edge; check every explanation for readable wrapping/scrolling.
Compare English localization and available screen work area, separating text clipping from the intentional ability to extend outside the parent.
reproduce.expected: All help text should be reachable and readable within the available work area; the flyout need not be restricted to the parent window dimensions.
